eje: the colour of the background behind the product, and nothing else
escena: SCENE (documentary, a real photograph in Efeonce's creative studio in Santiago, during the review of an AI-assisted production): on a matte dark-grey pin wall, TWELVE printed proofs of ONE product shot are pinned in a regular grid of three columns and four rows: the same fictitious matte-white bottle of skin serum, the same angle, the same light, the same crop, the same soft shadow on the same stone plinth; only the background colour behind the bottle changes from proof to proof, in calm tones of sand, sage, clay, fog grey and pale blue. Each proof is held by one cobalt (#0375DB) pushpin, the blue carrier of the frame. Caught at the instant ONE proof is being pulled off the wall, its pushpin still in the hand's fingers, and held forward toward the camera by a real hand and forearm entering from the right edge of the frame; that chosen proof carries ONE small round vivid orange (#FF6500) sticker in its corner, the only warm accent in the frame. The rest of the grid stays pinned, slightly out of focus behind the chosen one. Light: one large cool window light from the left, soft, with a gentle shadow under each proof; no lamps, no practical lights. Camera at eye height, about one metre from the wall, 50mm f/2.8. Real paper texture on the proofs, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No faces, no readable text, no logos of any brand, no screens.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus dark edge of a review table in front of the pin wall, in the shadow below the window light
